name: John Wick Arsenal
author: YourName
description: A comprehensive John Wick weapon pack featuring his most iconic firearms from the film series. Includes 10 weapons: H&K P30L, Glock 34, STI 2011 Combat Master, TTI Pit Viper, Benelli M4, TTI TR-1 Ultralight, Kel-Tec KSG, Remington 1875, Throwing Knives, and the legendary Pencil.
